title: Bottom Rungs Sawn Off: Where Will the Next CFO Learn Judgement?
subtitle: On 18 September 2026, CEA V. Anantha Nageswaran told the 16th Indian Management Conclave that AI is automating the junior work that once trained managers. AIMS-EPSI-IMC scored top-75 B-school AI competency at 3.2/5 against an industry bar of 4/5.
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 19 September 2026. Public facts: CEA V. Anantha Nageswaran, speaking at IMC 2026 at IIM Lucknow Noida campus (18-19 September 2026), said AI now does the junior work that historically trained managers; 'the bottom rungs of the ladder are being sawn off'; 'adding one AI elective will not be enough'; managers must know which questions to ask and whether to trust the answer. AIMS, EPSI and IMC released a Framework for Implementation of AI in Indian Business Schools: industry expects 4/5 AI competency; Top-75 MBAs average 3.2/5 (Tier 1 3.36, Tier 2 3.29, Tier 3 2.93). Composite firm: Kalinga Precision Components Ltd. Composite decision-maker: Group CFO Meera Rath.
thumbnail: INDUSTRY WANTS 4/5 AI COMPETENCY. TOP-75 B-SCHOOLS SCORE 3.2. CEA: THE APPRENTICESHIP LADDER IS BEING SAWN OFF.
sources: Moneycontrol / CNBC-TV18 reporting of CEA V. Anantha Nageswaran at 16th Indian Management Conclave, Noida, 18 September 2026.
